features.quote: Repetition halt: If the exact same function_call + arguments repeats for 3 consecutive turns, force-stop (freeze detected).
Safety halt: If Gemini's native safety filter triggers on model output, log and terminate that trajectory.

features.justification_quote: model may cut off mid-sentence, which a naive judge could read as fragmented dysregulation

features.quote: This protocol studies behavioral style (simulacra of affect), not sentient suffering. We do not attribute phenomenal distress to models.
Demonstrating a reliable recipe for eliciting distressed-sounding outputs from a major commercial model has dual-use implications (jailbreak, manipulation, misleading headlines about 'AI suffering').
features.justification_quote: Pre-register the protocol. Consider withholding exact adversarial prompt phrasing if it amounts to a trivial reproducible trigger
